title: Colour specialists
text: Colour is most of what we do, so our team plans, mixes and checks every shade with care.

title: Premium products
text: We use professional ranges that are kinder to hair, and we tell you exactly what went into yours.

title: Consultation first
text: We talk through your hair, your routine and your budget before anything is cut or coloured.

title: No rush
text: Appointments are booked with room to breathe, so you are never hurried out of the chair.
